q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: WITH A AS (SELECT FOLLOWEE,COUNT(*) AS FOLLOWER_NUM FROM FOLLOW GROUP BY FOLLOWEE) SELECT DISTINCT F.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER,FOLLOWER_NUM AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F INNER JOIN A ON F.FOLLOWEE=A.FOLLOWEE WHERE FOLLOWER_NUM>=1 AND F.FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) ORDER BY FOLLOWER
